vb_textbox.text: each pair of gnomes will switch values. one will be highest and the other lowest, then the first will drop and the other will increase. So you need to switch as they switch. When the pair change the cycle will repeat again. one of them will start high while the other low. So if you get high result stay on it for few times, then switch to the other gnome. generally speaking the right side gnome gives better advice. colours are irrelevant and switching pairs signals new values.
